reason: B proposes the more physically credible isovalent refractory substitution: Nb is much lighter than Ta yet has similar BCC chemistry and high-temperature strengthening capability, making density reduction with retained strength more plausible and directly testable. A’s Hf-to-Ti substitution likely reduces lattice-distortion and high-temperature strength, is contradicted by its own evidence linking reduced Hf to lower yield strength, and its claimed 10–15% density reduction is not well supported.
